messages:
sam: Quick thread 10-min sync for rehearsal tomorrow. Need: A/B headline, one gated asset, speaker one-liners, and a crisp fallback script.
marta: A/B ideas: A) 'Practical inference savings: config, quant, and caching' B) 'Shrink model spend without breaking latency'. Run for 72h on 5% sample.
jin: Gated asset = full CSV + runnable scripts + a short '15-minute try' checklist. Good balance for sales-ready leads.
cara: Speakers: jin demo lead, marta benchmark, sam host. If jin unavailable, play pre-recorded clip + live host walkthrough.
ops-bot: Calendar notice: Rehearsal slots created: tech-check (48h), full-run (24h), dress (2h). Green-room link in event.
marta: One-liners for host to memorize: 1) "We optimize for predictable latency and lower cost so your app stays fast." 2) fallback: "We'll show the same result via a short clip while we restore live responses."
sam: Fallback pseudocode for demo ops team:
```
monitor.latency(window=120s) > 1.8s/token ->
  switch_to_prepared_clip()
  post('#present','demo switched to clip - resuming shortly')
```
jin: I'll prep a 90s backup clip and upload to staging CDN. Link will go in green-room doc. Also adding warm-cache steps in demo script.
cara: Marketing asks: 1) 2 tweet variants + LI copy, 2) 30s promo script, 3) gated asset landing page text. Sam will draft CTAs.
marta: Post-rehearsal: each rehearsal reply here with 3-bullet postmortem: wins, one fix, slide edits. We'll use that to finalize landing copy and follow-up email.
sam: Agreed. Please be in green room 20min before show. See you all tomorrow. :thumbsup:
